title: Measurement, Templating and Installation Linkage Terms Across the Ridgeline Special Order Services Programs
content:
Whether a Ridgeline Special Order Services order must be made from a Ridgeline installer's measurements, whether a measuring error is remade free, whether an on-site template must come first, and whether the order may supply an installation contract are program terms.

## Terms

- **Ridgeline measure required** — whether the order may be placed only from measurements taken by a Ridgeline installer.
- **Ridgeline measure guarantee** — whether an item that does not fit because of a Ridgeline installer's measurement is remade at no charge.
- **Template visit required** — whether production may start only after the installer's on-site template is recorded.
- **Installation linkage** — whether the order may be linked to a Ridgeline Installation Services contract as its materials.
- **Free storage for linked items** — whether an item linked to an installation contract is stored free at the store until its installation date.

## Program terms

| Program | Ridgeline measure required | Ridgeline measure guarantee | Template visit required | Installation linkage | Free storage for linked items |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Special Order Catalog Merchandise | no | no | no | no | no |
| Ridgeline Special Order Cut-to-Order Flooring | no | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Made-to-Measure Window Coverings | no | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Windows and Exterior Doors | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Semi-Custom Cabinetry | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| Ridgeline Special Order Fabricated Countertops | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Points of reading

- Catalog Merchandise is the one program that cannot be linked to an installation contract, has no measure guarantee and therefore no free storage for linked items.
- A Ridgeline installer's measurements are required for Windows and Exterior Doors, Semi-Custom Cabinetry and Fabricated Countertops.
- Only Fabricated Countertops requires the installer's on-site template before production.
